[EN] Lots of people here show off how brave they are, and lots of them get hurt in the process. I was dispatched here to help them.
[ES] Mucha gente aquí presume de valiente, y muchos de ellos salen heridos en el proceso. Me enviaron aquí para ayudarlos.
